findings.description: The KMS key does not have automatic key rotation enabled (enable_key_rotation is not set to true), which weakens cryptographic hygiene and increases the risk of prolonged exposure if the key material is ever compromised.

findings.issue_category: missing key policy / overly permissive default
findings.description: No key policy is defined for the KMS key, meaning it falls back to the default policy that grants full access to the entire AWS account (all IAM principals with appropriate account-level permissions), which can be overly permissive for a key protecting log data.
